description: This file contains utility functions for normalizing strings, including trimming, lowercasing, replacing whitespace with hyphens, and cleaning unwanted characters. The functions are designed to process strings and arrays of strings, often used for generating URL-friendly slugs.

methods.name: export function normalizeStringEntries(list?: ReadonlyArray<unknown>) { normalizeStringEntries
methods.description: Converts an array of unknown entries to strings, trims whitespace, and filters out falsy values.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: Optional array of entries to normalize.

methods.body: Processes each entry in the array, converting to string and trimming whitespace.

methods.name: export function normalizeStringEntriesLower(list?: ReadonlyArray<unknown>) { normalizeStringEntriesLower
methods.description: Normalizes an array of entries to lowercase strings, trimming whitespace.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: Optional array of entries to normalize and convert to lowercase.

methods.body: Calls normalizeStringEntries and converts each string to lowercase.

methods.name: export function normalizeHyphenSlug(raw?: string | null) { normalizeHyphenSlug
methods.description: Converts a string into a URL-friendly hyphen-separated slug by trimming, lowering case, replacing whitespace, removing invalid characters, and cleaning multiple hyphens.
methods.body: Processes the input string through trimming, lowercasing, replacing whitespace, removing unwanted characters, and cleaning hyphens.

methods.name: export function normalizeAtHashSlug(raw?: string | null) { normalizeAtHashSlug
methods.description: Converts a string starting with '@' or '#' into a URL-friendly hyphenated slug, removing prefixes, replacing whitespace and underscores, and cleaning unwanted characters.
methods.body: Processes the input string through trimming, lowercasing, removing prefixes, replacing whitespace/underscores, removing unwanted characters, and cleaning hyphens.
